metadata.C_rule: the tide level of this map is EOT20 alone: C from the non-tidal level of the gauge, by the rule used at Villaviciosa
metadata.C_source: Mean difference between the Ferrol tide gauge (IOC fer2), tied to NMMA, and the tide level of this map, at 143 of its 189 images
metadata.attribution: MAREA products by the authors of the MAREA project (see CITATION.cff in the repository), CC BY 4.0. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel-2 data processed in the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. Tide: EOT20 (Hart-Davis et al., 2021, Earth System Science Data 13, 3869-3884; CC BY 4.0) and, where stated, sea-level records of the IOC Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility (VLIZ/IOC-UNESCO).
metadata.datums: EOT20 tide model at the site, 19 years (2007-2025) every 10 min. LAT and HAT: its lowest and highest levels. MSL: its mean. MLWS, MLWN, MHWN and MHWS: the means of its tidal-day low and high waters on spring and on neap days.
metadata.description: Contours of the MAREA elevation map at the tidal datums of the site.
metadata.drawn: A datum is drawn only between the 1st and 99th percentiles of the mapped heights, inside the automatic intertidal mask.
metadata.level_m: m above the mean sea level of the tide model at the site (the zero of the map heights)
metadata.level_nmma_m: m above NMMA (mean sea level at Alicante): level_m + C
metadata.map: MAREA elevation from 189 Sentinel-2 images (2022-2026), inside the automatic intertidal mask, smoothed with a 10 m Gaussian; lines of 100 m or more, simplified to 2.5 m.
metadata.preliminary: Preliminary: the mask was made by a rule and not checked by hand, and these elevations have no accuracy assessment (no survey of the ground at this site).
metadata.title: Tide lines
